name: V-Dem democracy indices 2024
source: V-Dem via Our World in Data, https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/<index>.csv

shared_construction.note:
V-Dem's liberal, participatory, deliberative and egalitarian
indices each INCORPORATE the electoral democracy index by
construction. Four of these five columns contain the fifth.
Their correlation is therefore a property of the formula, not
a measurement, and this table cannot support a claim that the
five varieties of democracy are really one. Testing that needs
the component indices with the shared electoral term removed.
